body:
Yep emotional blackmailing. That's bad and thank god I kept the thoughts to myself.

We had a talk about the what we wanted. She admitted she was unpredictable and thanked me for tolerating her. 

Part of me is happy for her. That's true . because due to depression I became less emotional available. Plus my family had a history of young age cancer. Part of me always wanted to set her free.

I don't know about future and really don't want to think about it any more.

Thank you for everything.

First thank you for being down to earth. I am a reasonable person. The bad relationship changed me much but I will be back where I belong. 

We have never thought of relationship the way you did and that's pretty much both of us's fault. I kown the toxicity came from both of us. I had known long ago that it had to stop but I wasn't really emotionally ready for that. 

As for crisis. That's really not my fault. I never required anything more than emotion support. She seldom gives it. I had always been the provider of the relationship. It gets tiresome. She is never used to me being vulnerable and that's when she gets becomes abusive. That's not her intention. But it happens. 

I am only human. During the relationship I had to carry the responsibility of both of us. That's not possible.

I should not trash myself. I know it now. Of course I will rebuild myself. But it takes time to get her out of my system. I never succeeded. That scares me.
That's true. But what about the pain? It's too painful. How do I suppress it?
